name: office-list
title: Office list
description: Every office with address, phone, email and hours, with an open-now line worked out in each office's own time zone and the zone said in words.
docs: Pass the offices (an id, a city, an optional name, the address as lines, a phone, an email, an IANA time zone, the hours, a directions link and an optional map), a title and a layout of list or tabs. Hours are ranges of days with an opening and a closing time on the 24-hour clock in the office's own zone; a second range for the same days is a lunch break, and a day with no range is closed. A day with two ranges shows them one under the other, each on a line that never breaks, so no time is ever split across lines at any width. The open-now line, the highlighted weekday and the local time are worked out after the page has mounted, because the server does not know the reader's clock, so the markup always matches; until then the line is empty and nothing jumps. Every office also says its time zone in words, using the generic name so it never changes with daylight saving. The status reads Open now, until 18:00 or Closed, opens at 09:00, tomorrow or on a named weekday. The address, phone and email share one address element, the phone is a tel link and the email a mailto link. The list layout shows every office at once as rows; the tabs layout shows one at a time with its map beside the details. Pass now to pin the lines for a test, locale for weekday names and the zone name, and labels to translate every fixed word. The week is built here and not with OpeningHours, on purpose: it needs two ranges in a day, a zone for each office and a clock that is known only after mount, where OpeningHours takes finished text and a day index from you.
